_about: The AI's skill numbers (sim/director/ai.gd, DirAI; sim/director/interrupt.gd). Under ADR 0008 the AI plays by the player's rules: it gets an outcome only by an input, and these numbers say how often it makes that input. 'level' is the level a match runs at unless the host sets another; step 4 makes it a per-slot setup key.

pressReact._note: Press (stance-matrix.md section 7.2): a trade or a counter needs the defender's own attack request. Attacked in this stance, the AI has a request in with this chance (one draw; the request goes through its queue). AGGRESSIVE: it trades instead of taking a clean hit. EVASIVE: it counters after a dodge instead of dodging clean. A guard never counters by itself.

_beamAnswer: kept for readers of the old shape: the medium level's value. The director reads levels.<level>.beamAnswer
_sigPick: the chance an AI attack is the signature, with 50 ki and the cooldown over: about 3 signatures a match (band 2 to 4)

perfectBlock._note: stance-matrix.md R5: the chance the AI perfect-blocks a strike with a window, by the state it holds (guard, press; none while dodging or escaping), plus heavyAdd against a heavy or an ender. Each level multiplies it by perfectBlockMul (moveset-rules.md section 11(g): 0.35, 0.6, 1.0)

levels._note: beamAnswer: control-rules.md section 10 (0.15, 0.35, 0.60). perfectBlockMul: its share of the perfectBlock rates above (band: 3 to 8, 5 to 15 and 12 to 20 perfect blocks per 100 melee exchanges). guardRepeat: weight added to its Guard choice while the rival repeats one attack. punish: the chance it attacks in the punish window after it blocked a whole string, and punishHeavy the share of those attacks that are heavies. reversal: [after 2 s of guard with over 25 ki, otherwise]; medium is R4 (50%, 20%). breakGuard: the share of its attacks that are heavies against a rival it has found guarding twice running. riposte: the chance it takes its riposte after a perfect block. burstAtLink: the chain link at which it bursts out (0: never). launchIntent: the chance its heavy is thrown with a direction, to launch (the earned launch's third rule; its stick is its flight path, so this stands for a player's tilt). heldHeavy: the chance it charges a heavy by holding it (the first rule).
